scripts.dev:ui: cd frontend && (test -d node_modules || npm install --no-audit --no-fund) && npx ng serve --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8080 --poll 1000 --configuration=local
scripts.dev:stack: concurrently -c auto -n api,ui "npm run api:dev" "npm run dev:ui"
scripts.build: cd frontend && (test -d node_modules || npm install --no-audit --no-fund) && npx ng build
scripts.api:dev: cd backend && (test -d node_modules || npm install --no-audit --no-fund) && npm run dev
